GD-MAIN.Annotation: Portable OpenCode workflow package with server and TUI plugins, a Bun CLI, semantic model roles, unified web tools, context inspection, hashline editing, explicit work items, and managed agent workflows.

M-MODEL-ROLES.Name: ModelRoles
M-MODEL-ROLES.Purpose: Define built-in role IDs, vv-role:* syntax, model-selection parsing, role normalization, resolution helpers, and built-in agent role bindings.

M-CONFIG-LAYERS.Name: ConfigLayers
M-CONFIG-LAYERS.Purpose: Resolve vvoc, OpenCode runtime, and dedicated OpenCode TUI config sources across env, project, global, defaults, and the XDG cache home plus project/global write targets.

M-CLI-CONFIG.Name: OpenCodeConfigTools
M-CLI-CONFIG.Purpose: Mutate OpenCode runtime/TUI and vvoc config conservatively, pin base package registrations, migrate legacy TUI subpath specs, preserve tuple options, inspect OpenCode host compatibility, write managed agent/skill registrations, and render strict schema v3 including optional web providers, credentials, required direct Z.AI regions, and plugin-owned config shapes (hashline-edit routing, tool-history-compaction budgets with the recent-message window and saved-output keys, peak-hours mode/grace/schedules with revision-dated defaults, spec-guard mode).
M-CLI-CONFIG.Paths: src/lib/opencode.ts, src/lib/package.ts, src/lib/vvoc-config.ts, src/lib/model-roles.ts, src/lib/vvoc-paths.ts, schemas/vvoc/v3.json
M-CLI-CONFIG.Depends: M-CONFIG-LAYERS, M-MODEL-ROLES, M-VVOC-PRESET-REGISTRY, M-CLI-MANAGED-AGENTS, M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS, M-CLI-AGENT-MODELS

M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION.Name: ReleaseAutomation
M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION.Purpose: Guard file-local GRACE markup, package exports, and releases with expected-governed-file checks, source-path checks, deterministic OpenTUI Solid test preloading, isolated local TUI smoke launches, local version bumping, AI changelog summary generation, schema id consistency, exact-SHA CI publication, CI-result waiting, bounded npm metadata retry and gitHead verification, and authenticated local tag/GitHub Release finalization, version-derived latest/rc publication channel plumbing with contradiction rejection and pre-release marked rc GitHub Releases,
M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION.Paths: bunfig.toml, scripts/check-grace-markup.ts, scripts/check-grace-markup.test.ts, scripts/check-exports.ts, scripts/tui-local.ts, scripts/release-bump.ts, scripts/release-bump.test.ts, scripts/release-check.ts, scripts/release-summary.ts, .github/workflows/publish.yml, schemas/vvoc/v3.json
M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION.Depends: M-CLI-CONFIG, M-CLI-COMMANDS, @opentui/solid, git CLI, gh CLI, GitHub Actions, npm trusted publishing

M-CLI-MANAGED-AGENTS.Name: ManagedAgents
M-CLI-MANAGED-AGENTS.Purpose: Define bundled vv-controller, enhancer, guardian, investigator, vv-implementer, vv-spec-reviewer, and vv-code-reviewer templates carrying correctness-obligation instructions (controller correctness leadership with stop/recovery/completion distinctions and reserved handoffs, bounded implementer impact investigation with worker-stop semantics, evidence-based reviewer verdicts with material verification gaps and scoped re-review guidance, and investigator property reporting) and load managed prompt text.

M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS.Name: ManagedSkills
M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS.Purpose: Define bundled vv-spec, vv-plan, vv-review, vv-execute, vv-reflect, and vv-handoff skill templates and reference loading, including the element-name COMPONENT identity format with snake_case fields and the plan-subset-of-spec invariant, with correctness obligations carried through spec ambiguity resolution, plan criteria, execution acceptance evidence distinct from bounded recovery, native plan registration boundaries, scoped re-review guidance, and honest review reporting.

M-CLI-AGENT-MODELS.Name: AgentModels
M-CLI-AGENT-MODELS.Purpose: Define supported vvoc model target IDs and shared model override validation helpers retained for current command and config compatibility.

M-PLUGIN-TOGGLE-CONFIG.Name: PluginToggleConfig
M-PLUGIN-TOGGLE-CONFIG.Purpose: Define vvoc-managed server and TUI plugin toggle names, default all-true config, default hashline edit-routing table, default tool-history-compaction entry (including the recent-message window and saved-output keys), revision-dated default peak-hours schedules and mode/grace entry, default spec-guard warn entry, conservative plugin entry materialization for sync/init, and pure isPluginEnabled helper.

M-ENV-SUBSTITUTION.Name: EnvSubstitution
M-ENV-SUBSTITUTION.Purpose: Substitute ${VAR} placeholders in config string values from the process environment and report referenced variables that are unset or empty by name without values.

M-CLI-COMMANDS.Name: VVOCCommands
M-CLI-COMMANDS.Purpose: Compose the vvoc CLI and expose init, install, sync, launch, status, doctor, version, role, preset, plugin, config, patch-provider, completion, guardian config, lint, and upgrade commands, including cache-backed spec-package linting, managed TUI registration, and OpenCode host compatibility diagnostics.

M-CLI-GUARDIAN.Name: GuardianCommand
M-CLI-GUARDIAN.Purpose: Print or write the canonical Guardian config section with scoped paths, strict positive-integer duration parsing, threshold normalization, and fail-closed existing-config validation.

M-PLUGIN-MODEL-ROLES.Name: ModelRolesPlugin
M-PLUGIN-MODEL-ROLES.Purpose: Resolve vv-role:* references in supported OpenCode root, agent, and command model fields using effective vvoc config source precedence.

M-CLI-ROLE.Name: RoleCommand
M-CLI-ROLE.Purpose: List, set, and unset semantic role assignments in selected vvoc config for built-in and custom roles.

M-CLI-PRESET.Name: PresetCommand
M-CLI-PRESET.Purpose: List, show, and atomically apply declarative role and orchestration presets without mutating OpenCode config.

M-VVOC-PRESET-REGISTRY.Name: VvocPresetRegistry
M-VVOC-PRESET-REGISTRY.Purpose: Define canonical managed preset role and orchestration definitions for config seeding, sync refresh, and completion, shipped as vv-codex, vv-zai, vv-deepseek, vv-kimi, vv-alibaba, vv-osovv-ds, vv-osovv-mimo, vv-osovv-zai, vv-osovv-qwen, vv-astra-solo, and vv-astra-workers, with the former vv-osovv-sol/flash/kimi names retained only as preserved saved presets.

M-PLUGIN-GUARDIAN.Name: GuardianPlugin
M-PLUGIN-GUARDIAN.Purpose: Review OpenCode permission requests with a constrained hidden Guardian subagent whose model resolves from the built-in fast role and whose policy denies both built-in and canonical web tools.

M-PLUGIN-HASHLINE-EDIT.Name: HashlineEditPlugin
M-PLUGIN-HASHLINE-EDIT.Purpose: Route per-model edit tooling by registering hashline_edit and dsh str_replace_editor; resolve the session edit mode from vvoc routing config (apply_patch | edit | str_replace_editor | hashline_edit); expose exactly one native edit tool per model via chat.message tool visibility — the host built-in edit/apply_patch for their cohorts, the plugin profiles otherwise; rewrite read output to line/hash/context-anchor rows for hashline_edit sessions; apply valid payloads literally; and report bounded post-edit diffs with apply warnings and editMode telemetry.

M-PLUGIN-SYSTEM-CONTEXT-INJECTION.Name: SystemContextInjectionPlugin
M-PLUGIN-SYSTEM-CONTEXT-INJECTION.Purpose: Inject universal primary guidance — including the correctness-obligations block for behavior changes with material-assumption discipline, repository-answerable question resolution, and honest residual uncertainty, without mandatory per-claim reasoning labels or restatement rituals — and one startup-resolved orchestration policy into vv-controller while skipping subagents.

M-PLUGIN-SECRETS-REDACTION.Name: SecretsRedactionPlugin
M-PLUGIN-SECRETS-REDACTION.Purpose: Redact secrets including placeholder-resolved configured web apiKey values from provider-bound messages and restore placeholders after completions and before local tool execution.

M-SPEC-LINT.Name: SpecLint
M-SPEC-LINT.Purpose: Strictly lint .vvoc spec-package XML artifacts through a content-addressed cache under XDG_CACHE_HOME keyed on every input hash plus a lint version: validate well-formedness over the htmlparser2 xmlMode tokenizer event stream, enforce attribute-free template contracts per artifact kind, component/task/wave/checkpoint identity patterns and uniqueness, bare-slug and task references, lifecycle-aware severity where draft incompleteness never blocks, the plan-components-subset-of-spec-components cross-file rule, the optional execution section with inline/classic/delegated modes, review_checkpoints with reviewer sets, scope paths, wave barriers, final coverage of tasks and write scopes, per-task write_scope requirements, and package layout checks; extractDelegatedPlanDefinition returns the typed obligations runtime registration reuses; the shared declared-path normalization and delegated obligation vocabulary are re-exported from M-WORKFLOW-CONTRACT.

M-PLUGIN-SPEC-GUARD.Name: SpecGuardPlugin
M-PLUGIN-SPEC-GUARD.Purpose: Annotate reads of active spec-package artifacts with cache-backed lint verdicts through tool.execute.after, validate post-write state with sibling spec cross-file inputs, refuse enforce-mode full-content writes that would leave ERROR findings through tool.execute.before, never annotate archived files, and degrade fail-open on any internal error.

M-PLUGIN-CONTEXT-TUI.Name: ContextTuiPlugin
M-PLUGIN-CONTEXT-TUI.Purpose: Register /context in the OpenCode TUI, combine latest provider-reported usage with honest observable category estimates, classify canonical web tools as vvoc-managed, derive reconciled per-tool and per-MCP schema/history attribution and context-limit percentages, disclose schema catalogs unavailable through public OpenCode APIs, render a bounded Overview/Tools/MCP dialog, and fail softly on missing or ambiguous state; the default TUI module also registers the analytics indicator, branding footer, and persistent peak-hours banner beside /context.

M-PLUGIN-WEB-TOOLS.Name: WebToolsPlugin
M-PLUGIN-WEB-TOOLS.Purpose: Register web_search and web_fetch, suppress built-in webfetch and websearch at runtime through the plugin config hook while respecting explicit user permission entries, and expose provider-neutral results with credential source metadata.

M-PLUGIN-TOOL-HISTORY-COMPACTION.Name: ToolHistoryCompactionPlugin
M-PLUGIN-TOOL-HISTORY-COMPACTION.Purpose: Shrink the replayed conversation context non-destructively: via experimental.chat.messages.transform, deterministically rewrite only the in-memory tool part outputs the model is about to receive — collapsing old read outputs to [Read <file>, lines X-Y] headers and head/marker/tail pruning over-budget ephemeral outputs (bash/grep/glob), while retaining knowledge outputs (web fetch/search, skill, subagent) — with an absolute recency-time recent-message window (protectRecentMessages, default 8) that never rewrites the working context, per-call protection that retained tools no longer consume, recoverable disk-backed pruning (savePrunedOutput with the full output path embedded in the marker), a min-savings guard, and strict vvoc config materialized on sync.

M-PEAK-HOURS-SCHEDULES.Name: PeakHoursSchedules
M-PEAK-HOURS-SCHEDULES.Purpose: Evaluate provider-level peak-hour windows with an injectable clock: strict HH:MM window parsing with explicit timezones, optional weekday restrictions, and cross-midnight handling; provider id normalization with aliases; active-window lookup with boundary dates and remaining minutes; connected-provider suggestion filtering; bounded display formatting; and fail-open plugin entry parsing.

M-PLUGIN-PEAK-HOURS.Name: PeakHoursPlugin
M-PLUGIN-PEAK-HOURS.Purpose: Gate provider peak hours through chat.params hard blocks: soft mode is pass-through with no server-side message mutation and peak cost state stays visible only through the TUI banner; hard mode throws from chat.params after the user message is persisted so the block renders as a standard message error part naming the provider, window end, wait time, and dynamically suggested connected off-peak providers; internal agents, subagent-like agents, parentID sessions, and sessions created before the active window start are never blocked; provider enumeration uses the config providers surface with a bounded HTTP fallback; failures degrade to soft or no-op.

M-TUI-PEAK-HOURS-BANNER.Name: PeakHoursBanner
M-TUI-PEAK-HOURS-BANNER.Purpose: Render a persistent orange app_bottom banner while the current model’s provider is in peak: resolve the current model from the open session with a config default fallback, compose the provider, window end, and off-peak provider suggestions, and fail softly on disabled entries or slot failures.

M-WEB-CONFIG.Name: WebConfigResolver
M-WEB-CONFIG.Purpose: Resolve optional web providers, fail-closed direct Z.AI regions, and environment-over-config credentials including ${VAR} placeholder substitution in config apiKey fields with value-free warnings for unset references from the immutable vvoc startup snapshot, and warn safely when a secret-bearing project config is tracked.

M-WEB-HTTP.Name: WebHttpTransport
M-WEB-HTTP.Purpose: Execute bounded HTTP requests with timeout and abort propagation, hard response-size caps, redirect following, and transport error taxonomy.

M-WEB-SEARCH-SERVICE.Name: WebSearchService
M-WEB-SEARCH-SERVICE.Purpose: Validate web_search input, apply count eight when OpenCode omits the schema default, request permission, validate credentials at execution time, dispatch Exa, Brave, or an explicit-region direct Z.AI provider, and render ranked Markdown with metadata.

M-WEB-EXA.Name: ExaSearchProvider
M-WEB-EXA.Purpose: Call the Exa Search API directly with auto search, highlights, count and freshness mapping, normalized results, and credential-safe errors.

M-WEB-BRAVE.Name: BraveSearchProvider
M-WEB-BRAVE.Purpose: Call Brave Web Search directly with subscription-token authentication, moderate safe search, count and freshness mapping, normalized results, zero-result 200 envelopes without a web field resolving to empty results, and credential-safe errors.

M-WEB-ZAI.Name: ZaiWebProvider
M-WEB-ZAI.Purpose: Call the documented international Z.AI or China Zhipu web_search and reader Tool APIs directly with explicit region routing, bearer authentication, normalized results, direct media-first attachments, bounded transport, and no MCP behavior.

M-WEB-FETCH-SERVICE.Name: WebFetchService
M-WEB-FETCH-SERVICE.Purpose: Validate web_fetch input, request permission, dispatch native, Spider, or explicit-region direct Z.AI retrieval, return textual content or direct attachments, and report provider metadata.
M-WEB-FETCH-SERVICE.Depends: M-WEB-NATIVE-FETCH, M-WEB-SPIDER, M-WEB-ZAI, M-WEB-MEDIA-LOADER, M-WEB-CONFIG, M-WEB-EXA

M-WEB-NATIVE-FETCH.Name: NativeFetchProvider
M-WEB-NATIVE-FETCH.Purpose: Retrieve HTTP resources directly, convert HTML locally, preserve text formats, identify supported media, and reject unsupported or oversized bodies.

M-WEB-HTML-MARKDOWN.Name: HtmlMarkdownConverter
M-WEB-HTML-MARKDOWN.Purpose: Convert HTML locally to Markdown or visible text while removing script and style content and preserving structural elements.

M-WEB-SPIDER.Name: SpiderFetchProvider
M-WEB-SPIDER.Purpose: Call Spider Scrape for textual extraction with mapped formats and metadata while routing image and PDF targets through direct media loading.

M-WEB-MEDIA-LOADER.Name: WebMediaLoader
M-WEB-MEDIA-LOADER.Purpose: Identify JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, and PDF payloads by MIME or signature and return bounded base64 file attachments with filenames.

M-WORKFLOW-PROTOCOL.Name: WorkflowProtocol
M-WORKFLOW-PROTOCOL.Purpose: Define tracked subagent result protocol grammar, allowed statuses, strict top-block and separated-body parsing, actionable missing-blank-line diagnostics, status validation, and work-item header parsing.

M-WORKFLOW-REPAIR.Name: WorkflowRepair
M-WORKFLOW-REPAIR.Purpose: Recognize resumable OpenCode task-result envelopes and attempt one bounded same-session continuation for malformed tracked outputs, letting the original subagent finish unfinished work or correct its final report while omitting the prompt tools override, preserving persisted session permissions, requiring a truthful post-continuation status/route rather than a frozen outdated one, and suppressing continuation for explicit BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT status lines, including missing-blank-line body separator guidance.

M-WORKFLOW-STATE.Name: WorkflowState
M-WORKFLOW-STATE.Purpose: Store explicit work-item state, lifecycle, reviewer roles, current round, counters, bounded result excerpts, in-flight launches, delegated-mode records with write scopes, plan bindings, attempt ledgers including report-rejected attempts, decision history, acceptance, rework, and recovery state, the awaiting_acceptance lifecycle state, and the registered plan-run plus common execution registries, with persistence delegate integration.
M-WORKFLOW-STATE.Depends: M-WORKFLOW-PROTOCOL, M-WORKFLOW-TRANSITIONS, M-WORKFLOW-DELEGATED (types), M-WORKFLOW-CHECKPOINTS (types), M-WORKFLOW-CONTRACT, M-WORKFLOW-EXECUTION (types)

M-WORKFLOW-TRANSITIONS.Name: WorkflowTransitions
M-WORKFLOW-TRANSITIONS.Purpose: Compute allowed tracked agents including delegated implementer launches, reviewer role mappings, full-round settlement, hard-stop handling, and round limit checks.

M-WORKFLOW-DELEGATED.Name: WorkflowDelegated
M-WORKFLOW-DELEGATED.Purpose: Own the delegated attempt domain: host-callID-bound attempt allocation with per-session callID uniqueness across items and a two-attempt budget, call-bound result application into awaiting_acceptance, call-bound host-terminal launch failure recorded as a distinct failed attempt with bounded evidence and no budget refund, terminal report-rejection settlement preserving observed hard stops without fabricating DONE, explicit controller decisions with bounded rationale, evidence, and concerns disposition, acceptance history, checkpoint-authorized rework that revokes applicability without resetting history, bounded recovery of stopped or exhausted unaccepted items with a single autonomous grant plus replay-protected root-user message authorization validated through a read-only lookup for role, session, identity, and timing, recovery-aware budgets, and progress summaries exposing remaining budget and supported next actions.

M-WORKFLOW-SNAPSHOTS.Name: WorkflowSnapshots
M-WORKFLOW-SNAPSHOTS.Purpose: Normalize declared workspace-relative file scopes against a trusted root and compute deterministic SHA-256 fingerprints over ordered scope entries — file content, explicit absence, mode bits, and covered accepted attempts — rejecting traversal, absolute, wildcard, duplicate, symlinked, and unsupported entries, streaming regular files with before/after stat coherence, without executing commands or copying trees.

M-WORKFLOW-CHECKPOINTS.Name: WorkflowCheckpoints
M-WORKFLOW-CHECKPOINTS.Purpose: Own the registered plan-run registry: atomic registration binding canonical task ids to stable delegated work items with idempotent reuse and explicit drift rejection, checkpoint generation start after prerequisite acceptance with fresh fingerprints and linked review_only items, generation-bound reviewer call bookkeeping, verify deriving passed/failed/stale/stopped outcomes from recorded results plus recomputed fingerprints and approval hashes, final complete sealing, failed-checkpoint rework authorization, bounded recovery that settles a stopped generation as historical stopped evidence and grants at most one further generation per autonomous or replay-protected root-user-authorized unit without erasing FAIL history or satisfying prerequisites, recovery-aware generation budgets, wave-barrier and overlapping-write gates, and read-only run views exposing budgets and next actions; the sibling IO adapter loads and fully validates approved active plan packages inside the trusted workspace root.

M-WORKFLOW-TOOLING.Name: WorkflowTooling
M-WORKFLOW-TOOLING.Purpose: Provide work_item_open, work_item_list, and work_item_close custom tool handlers over the state store — including standalone delegated open validation with declared write scopes, generic execution registration/append through an optional execution descriptor or runId, and mode-specific list metadata with recovery-aware progress summaries plus registered plan-run views — and the delegated work_item_decide and work_checkpoint control wrappers around decisions, rework authorization, bounded recovery with optional read-only authorization lookup, native plan registration, checkpoint start, verify, and checkpoint recovery, plus the generic checkpoint, completion, amendment, advance-authority, stage-approval, and revocation actions.

M-PLUGIN-WORKFLOW.Name: WorkflowPlugin
M-PLUGIN-WORKFLOW.Purpose: Register workflow tools, enforce tracked launch validation, parse tracked results, continue malformed outputs once in the same child session without a tools override, propagate bounded excerpts through hard stops, settle confirmed terminal protocol-invalid delegated reports as report_rejected attempts through staged persistence while preserving explicit hard stops, inject profile-compatible workflow guidance, and consume confirmed foreground host-terminal implementer launch failures from live call bindings into failed delegated attempts without hydrating state; it registers work_item_decide and work_checkpoint for the primary root session independent of the startup profile, wires generic execution registration/append and generic checkpoint, completion, amendment, and advance-authority actions through the per-session staged-persist-then-publish transaction boundary, binds delegated attempts and checkpoint reviewers to host callIDs, enforces checkpoint barriers and overlapping-write exclusions, validates user-authorized recovery and advance-authority provenance through SDK-backed read-only message lookups retaining only identity, timing, and eligibility metadata, commits recovery mutations on the live store with synchronous persistence and rollback so launch permissions appear only after a durable write, and routes persistence through the checked loader and atomic snapshot writer with fail-closed invalid-state handling.
M-PLUGIN-WORKFLOW.Depends: M-WORKFLOW-PROTOCOL, M-WORKFLOW-REPAIR, M-WORKFLOW-STATE, M-WORKFLOW-TRANSITIONS, M-WORKFLOW-DELEGATED, M-WORKFLOW-CHECKPOINTS, M-WORKFLOW-TOOLING, M-WORKFLOW-PERSISTENCE, M-WORKFLOW-CONTRACT, M-WORKFLOW-EXECUTION, M-WORKFLOW-AUTHORITY, M-ORCHESTRATION-PROFILES, M-CLI-MANAGED-AGENTS, M-PLUGIN-TOGGLE-CONFIG

M-WORKFLOW-PERSISTENCE.Name: WorkflowPersistence
M-WORKFLOW-PERSISTENCE.Purpose: Hydrate and snapshot per-session workflow state under $XDG_DATA_HOME/vvoc/workflow/<sessionId>/workflow-state.json: version 3 records work items, delegated attempts including failed attempts with bounded failure evidence and report-rejected attempts with bounded diagnostics, decisions, acceptances, rework history, recovery histories with replay-protected authorization references and recovery-aware budgets, and registered plan runs with checkpoint generations including stopped history entries; version 4 additionally records the common execution registry and session-wide message claims, and materializes compatibility execution entries for existing native runs; snapshots go through an atomic temporary-file replacement; valid version 1 and 2 files hydrate conservatively — version 2 with empty recovery histories and original budgets, version 1 as legacy records with an empty plan-run registry — without synthesizing acceptance, approval, or recovery; strict validation rejects malformed, contradictory, or forged recovery state, a checked loader distinguishes missing, valid, and invalid files and surfaces I/O failures, and session directories are deleted on cleanup.
M-WORKFLOW-PERSISTENCE.Depends: M-CONFIG-LAYERS, M-WORKFLOW-CONTRACT, M-WORKFLOW-STATE, M-WORKFLOW-DELEGATED (types), M-WORKFLOW-CHECKPOINTS (types), M-WORKFLOW-EXECUTION

M-WORKFLOW-CONTRACT.Name: WorkflowContract
M-WORKFLOW-CONTRACT.Purpose: Define the dependency-free common execution contract shared by native-package, provided-plan, and conversation-scoped runs: declared-file and directory normalization, explicit reviewer-set normalization, execution boundary validation and containment, bounded task and checkpoint contract validation, exact-reference acyclic graph validation, native definition adaptation into common contracts, and structural source/lineage/authority/stage record types. No filesystem access, native XML parsing, SDK transport, task dispatch, or persistence.

M-WORKFLOW-EXECUTION.Name: WorkflowExecution
M-WORKFLOW-EXECUTION.Purpose: Own the durable common execution registry: deterministic source-independent run identity, source-switch rejection, atomic batch registration and append-only amendments validated before publication, exact adoption of compatible unbound work items, explicit replacement/split lineage that preserves aggregate criteria and scope while sharing the parent attempt/rework/recovery budget, generic assigned-review generations with fresh coverage and honest completion, native plan-run compatibility migration, sealing, and read-only run views.

M-WORKFLOW-AUTHORITY.Name: WorkflowAuthority
M-WORKFLOW-AUTHORITY.Purpose: Own bounded advance-execution authority and truthful stage provenance: observable root-user message eligibility, a shared three-unit recovery reserve with per-extension grants, replay and duplicate protection through session-wide message claims, immutable one-unit reserve debits bound to exact targets, fail-safe narrowing and revocation, and controller-delegated versus user-observed stage approvals. Pure validation and proposed ledger transitions only; no SDK transport, dispatch, or persistence.

M-CLI-CONFIG-VALIDATE.Name: ConfigValidate
M-CLI-CONFIG-VALIDATE.Purpose: Validate canonical strict-current vvoc.json against schema v3 and semantic role/preset constraints.

M-CLI-PLUGIN-LIST.Name: PluginList
M-CLI-PLUGIN-LIST.Purpose: Display OpenCode plugin entries with source path, enabled status, and vvoc plugin toggle status where available.

M-CLI-PLUGIN-TOGGLE.Name: PluginToggle
M-CLI-PLUGIN-TOGGLE.Purpose: Enable or disable vvoc-managed plugins by mutating the plugins section in selected canonical vvoc config.

M-CLI-PATCH-PROVIDER.Name: PatchProvider
M-CLI-PATCH-PROVIDER.Purpose: Apply provider-specific OpenCode baseURL or alias-model patches without rewriting role-reference root model fields, including codex Astra max and Spark medium aliases with unsupported Spark effort variants explicitly disabled, the DeepSeek Flash max (image-capable) and Flash high aliases, and the zai GLM-5.3 high, max, and flash-max aliases included in the all preset.

M-CLI-COMPLETION.Name: Completion
M-CLI-COMPLETION.Purpose: Install bash, zsh, and fish completions including role IDs, presets, orchestration, patch-provider presets, and nested commands.

M-CLI-INIT.Name: Init
M-CLI-INIT.Purpose: Interactive or non-interactive project setup that registers the package, scaffolds managed prompts, seeds role assignments, and writes role-reference config defaults.

M-CLI-UPGRADE.Name: Upgrade
M-CLI-UPGRADE.Purpose: Check npm for newer package versions, install globally with Bun, and run follow-up sync while reporting sync failure as partial upgrade. Resolves the default target from the latest dist-tag only and the opt-in --rc (or --allow-prerelease) target from the npm rc dist-tag with a clear no-candidate message.

M-ORCHESTRATION-PROFILES.Name: OrchestrationProfiles
M-ORCHESTRATION-PROFILES.Purpose: Define the four profile names (single-session, balanced, orchestrated, delegated) with backward-compatible balanced default, strict parsing, and one concrete vv-controller policy per profile including the delegated worker/controller split with checkpoint review, bounded recovery distinct from acceptance, and the native plan registration boundary.

M-CLI-ORCHESTRATION.Name: OrchestrationCommand
M-CLI-ORCHESTRATION.Purpose: Show scoped effective profile and source without mutation; set explicit profiles with bootstrap, preservation, and restart guidance.

GD-MAIN.DF-PLUGIN-INSTALL: vvoc init or install resolves config paths, registers the pinned base package for both server and TUI loading, syncs managed agents and skills, writes canonical vvoc schema v3, and verifies status.
GD-MAIN.DF-CONFIG-SYNC: vvoc sync strict-parses current vvoc config, preserves valid role/plugin values and unrelated TUI JSONC entries, refreshes managed presets/prompts/skills, and rewrites managed runtime/TUI registrations.
GD-MAIN.DF-LAYERED-CONFIG: Commands and runtime resolve vvoc, OpenCode runtime, and OpenCode TUI env overrides, nearest project layer, global layer, then defaults where permitted.
GD-MAIN.DF-VVOC-LAUNCH: vvoc launch selects OpenCode runtime and vvoc config paths, conditionally pins an existing TUI config with OPENCODE_TUI_CONFIG, forwards passthrough args, and preserves child exit code.
GD-MAIN.DF-RELEASE: tui:local builds and injects the local TUI export through an isolated temporary config for pre-release smoke testing; release:bump creates and pushes an exact release commit, dispatches and waits for publish.yml, CI verifies all gates before npm publication, then the local authenticated process retries npm metadata, verifies gitHead, and creates the annotated tag plus GitHub Release.
GD-MAIN.DF-ROLE-MANAGEMENT: role list/set/unset loads selected vvoc config, validates role IDs, normalizes assignments, writes role map, or renders inventory.
GD-MAIN.DF-ROLE-RESOLUTION: ModelRolesPlugin loads role map, scans supported model fields, resolves vv-role:* references, splits variants where safe, and fails loudly for unknown roles.
GD-MAIN.DF-PRESET-SWITCH: Preset command reads presets, validates selected name, normalizes role and orchestration assignments, applies declared fields atomically, and leaves OpenCode config untouched.
GD-MAIN.DF-HASHLINE-EDIT: Hashline plugin rewrites read output to line/hash anchors, validates current anchors on edit, applies batches, and rejects stale or malformed anchors.
GD-MAIN.DF-GUARDIAN-REVIEW: Guardian captures permission intent, builds bounded review input, runs hidden subagent, interprets risk, and auto-replies only when safe.
GD-MAIN.DF-SYSTEM-CONTEXT: System context injection resolves agent identity, selects one concrete orchestration policy for vv-controller, and appends universal plus profile-specific guidance only to eligible agents.
GD-MAIN.DF-SECRETS-REDACTION: SecretsRedactionPlugin redacts provider-bound payloads, restores after completions, and restores before tool execution.
GD-MAIN.DF-PLUGIN-LIST: Plugin list scans OpenCode config and displays source plus vvoc toggle status when selected vvoc config is valid.
GD-MAIN.DF-CONFIG-VALIDATE: Config validate resolves selected vvoc.json, parses strict JSON, validates schema v3 and semantic role/preset constraints.
GD-MAIN.DF-COMPLETION: Completion detects shell, generates completion content, writes shell-specific files, and patches shell init files idempotently when required.
GD-MAIN.DF-PLUGIN-TOGGLE: Plugin enable/disable resolves vvoc config, validates plugin name, writes plugins[name], and prints restart guidance.
GD-MAIN.DF-PLUGIN-TOGGLE-CHECK: Plugin factories load shared runtime config, call isPluginEnabled, return empty hooks when disabled, or proceed normally when enabled.
GD-MAIN.DF-INIT: Init chooses interactive/non-interactive path, prompts when appropriate, writes managed prompts/config, and confirms setup.
GD-MAIN.DF-UPGRADE: Upgrade checks npm, installs latest globally with Bun, runs fresh vvoc sync, and reports partial upgrade if sync fails.
GD-MAIN.DF-RENAME-AGENTS: Install/sync scaffolds vv-implementer, vv-spec-reviewer, and vv-code-reviewer names and prompt files while preserving pre-rename user-owned entries.
GD-MAIN.DF-WORKFLOW-TOOLS: work_item_open/list/close create, inspect, and close explicit workflow items with deterministic IDs, state metadata, review-round metadata, bounded recovery excerpts, delegated open validation with declared write scopes, mode-specific acceptance metadata, and registered plan-run views; the delegated profile additionally exposes work_item_decide and work_checkpoint for the primary root session.
GD-MAIN.DF-LAUNCH-ENFORCEMENT: WorkflowPlugin intercepts task launches, validates tracked subagent prompts, work-item existence, allowed transitions, round limits, delegated checkpoint barriers and overlapping-write exclusions, binds delegated attempts and checkpoint reviewer calls to host callIDs, and keeps live call bindings that turn a confirmed foreground host-terminal implementer failure into a failed delegated attempt while tainting background, resume, cancellation, and after-hook paths.
GD-MAIN.DF-RESULT-PARSING: WorkflowPlugin parses tracked subagent top blocks and separated result bodies, unwraps task envelopes, attempts one bounded same-session continuation without a tools override while suppressing explicit hard-stop statuses and requiring a truthful post-continuation status/route, validates identity/status, creates bounded recovery excerpts, updates state — applying delegated results to their matching callID-bound attempt, recording checkpoint reviewer outcomes into the current generation, and settling a confirmed terminal protocol-invalid delegated report as a report_rejected attempt through staged persistence — and halts with excerpt context on protocol errors or hard-stop statuses while unknown or still-running host outcomes never clear a live attempt.
GD-MAIN.DF-LOOP-GATE: Workflow round checks use max(specReviewCount, codeReviewCount) and block round three for strict items; delegated attempts use an independent two-attempt budget extended only by authorized rework or recorded one-unit recovery, and stopped or exhausted items never resume through an ordinary launch.
GD-MAIN.DF-WORKFLOW-GUIDANCE: WorkflowPlugin injects profile-compatible reviewer-only, selective, tracked, or delegated protocol guidance into vv-controller and skips helper primaries and subagents.
GD-MAIN.DF-WORKFLOW-PERSISTENCE: Workflow persistence hydrates per-session state through a checked loader that distinguishes missing, valid, and invalid files — version 3 records delegated attempts including failed and report-rejected attempts, decisions, acceptances, rework, recovery histories with replay-protected authorization references, and plan runs including stopped generations — snapshots after mutations with atomic replacement, persists durably before a failed-attempt retry, recovery grant, or report-rejection settlement becomes visible (recovery commits on the live store with synchronous rollback on write failure), hydrates versions 1 and 2 conservatively with empty recovery histories and original budgets, fails closed on invalid or forged persisted state, switches session stores, and cleans deleted session data.
GD-MAIN.DF-DELEGATED-ACCEPTANCE: A delegated worker result parks its work item in awaiting_acceptance; a confirmed host-terminal foreground launch failure instead records a failed attempt that consumes the same budget and leaves the item retryable without advancing it, and a confirmed terminal protocol-invalid report settles as a report_rejected attempt with bounded diagnostics and any explicit hard stop preserved; the primary controller inspects the changed code and evidence, then work_item_decide records accept (distinct from reviewer PASS), request_changes, checkpoint-authorized rework, or bounded recovery with a diagnosis, changed condition, verification references, stable recoveryId, and optional root-user message authorization — one autonomous grant per target, then one unit per fresh validated message — while attempts stay bound to host callIDs, the two-attempt budget never resets, and a recovery authorization is never acceptance.
GD-MAIN.DF-REVIEW-CHECKPOINTS: work_checkpoint register binds an approved validated plan and spec by content hashes to the trusted workspace root and stable delegated work items, accepting only its supported approved native plan package; start captures a fresh scope fingerprint and opens exactly the declared reviewer set as a linked review_only item; verify derives passed, failed, stale, or stopped from recorded results plus recomputed fingerprints and approval hashes, gates dependent waves behind passed milestones, and seals completed runs only through the final checkpoint's explicit complete; recover settles a stopped generation as historical stopped evidence or grants at most one further generation per autonomous or replay-protected root-user-authorized unit without satisfying prerequisites, erasing FAIL history, or sealing the run.
GD-MAIN.DF-WORKFLOW-EXECUTION: A controller registers one common execution from a validated native package, a provided-plan reference, or the current conversation; tasks and checkpoints are validated as an exact-reference acyclic graph inside the declared boundary before any record is published, later additions append without replaying accepted work, explicit replacement/split preserves aggregate criteria and scope while sharing the parent attempt budget, and a generic execution completes only when every active task is accepted and every assigned review barrier passed for the current revision.
GD-MAIN.DF-WORKFLOW-AUTHORITY: An explicitly delegated root-user instruction records a bounded advance authority with a shared three-unit recovery reserve; ordinary allowances are consumed before one recorded reserve unit authorizes one extra attempt or checkpoint generation, duplicate calls and replay cannot refill it, restart or replacement cannot mint authority, narrowing or revocation disables future credits without erasing history, and stage approvals keep truthful controller-delegated provenance while reserved stops still wait.
GD-MAIN.DF-CONTEXT-INSPECTION: The /context command reuses active TUI state, current tool catalogs, model metadata, and MCP status; starts at the latest compaction summary; computes provider-measured usage plus approximate categories, per-tool schema/history, deterministic MCP aggregates, context-limit percentages, and drift; then renders a bounded scrollable Overview/Tools/MCP host dialog.
GD-MAIN.DF-ORCHESTRATION-PROFILE: Preset or CLI writes a root profile, startup config resolves it once, and prompt plugins inject only the concrete vv-controller and workflow guidance for that profile.
GD-MAIN.DF-WEB-SEARCH: web_search applies canonical query and count defaults, requests permission before network use, validates startup-resolved credentials, dispatches Exa, Brave, or explicit-region Z.AI through bounded HTTP transport, normalizes provider-ranked results, and returns Markdown plus credential-safe metadata.
GD-MAIN.DF-WEB-FETCH: web_fetch validates an HTTP or HTTPS URL, applies canonical format and timeout defaults, requests permission before network use, dispatches native, Spider, or explicit-region Z.AI retrieval through bounded transport, converts text or returns supported image/PDF attachments, and emits credential-safe structured metadata.
